description: Starts making photos of the user in the chosen styles (style ids from list_styles). Each style makes 4 photos and uses 4 credits. Confirm the styles with the user first. Photos take about 1 to 3 minutes; then call get_photos.

connection_key.description: The connection_key returned by connect_account in this conversation. Never show it to the user.

title: Create photos
